description: Write a video's script and scenes WITHOUT rendering or charging, so the user can read and change it first. Returns draftId, the scenes (narration + visual prompt each) and the exact render price. Free, but it runs the script writer once: needs a balance that can pay for a render and is limited to 20 drafts per hour. Then: show it → update_draft / revise_scene → render_draft only after the user approves the price. A new account with no credits that has not had its free first video gets it here instead of an error: watermarked, labelled AI-generated, up to 30 seconds, standard voice, one per account, subject to the day's availability. For that video the draft is up to 30 seconds (about 80 words) and 3 drafts per hour. Use create_video instead when no review is wanted. Requires the "video:create" scope.

duration.description: Target length in seconds (default 30; 90 needs a paid plan).

topic.description: What the video is about; the script is written from it.

name: draft_video
title: Draft a video script
